project_type: Next.js 16 real-time emotion detection app with App Router
build_system: npm with Next.js 16.3.0, Tailwind CSS 4, PostCSS
build_command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd /projects/sandbox/emociones-app && npm run build
verification_instructions: Run npm run build and confirm it succeeds with no TypeScript errors. Verify the app routes compile: / (main), /dashboard, /settings, plus all API routes.
setup_instructions: Node.js v22 via nvm. Dependencies already installed in node_modules.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. Must prefix all npm/node commands with: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" &&. Next.js 16 - check node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for any API differences before writing code.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md mandates reading node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for Next.js 16 breaking changes. The app uses client components ('use client' directive). App Router with route.ts for API endpoints.
key_patterns: Client-side 'use client' components with useState/useEffect. face-api.js for detection. FaceDetector component receives mode prop ('snapshot'|'contador'), face tracking with TrackedFace interface (id, centerX, centerY, width, height, lastSeen). Captures saved to Neon PostgreSQL via drizzle-orm. getEmotionBg() function returns CSS gradient strings for emotion styling. Mode toggle at bottom of detection view in page.tsx. Dashboard reads from emotion_captures table with jsonb 'emotions' field.
directory_structure: src/app/ (pages + API routes), src/components/ (FaceDetector.tsx), src/lib/ (utilities: emotions.ts, poems.ts, ai-config.ts, db.ts, schema.ts), public/models/ (face-api.js models), scripts/ (migrate.ts, download-models.sh)
